items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: I had Clarence -- he was a drummer, used to be with Dizzy. Clarence Johnson.

ctx.x: Well, let's go back now. What happened after you broke up this group then, with Joe?
Joe? I continued on with the group. I got Hugh Lawson . He played piano with me. And had the same group. Not Elvin, but I had Clarence -- he was a drummer, used to be with Dizzy. Clarence Johnson.
